scenarios.title: Pharmacy First funding caps
scenarios.blurb: Model how NHS England's Pharmacy First payment caps ripple through pharmacies, GPs, and patients.
scenarios.prompt: Model the second-order effects of NHS England payment caps on Pharmacy First consultations from March 2026: pharmacy multiples, independents, GPs, patients, NHS England — financial strain, patient access, workforce attrition, policy escalation.

scenarios.title: Energy price cap
scenarios.blurb: Model how a retail energy price cap hits suppliers, generators, Ofgem, and consumers.
scenarios.prompt: Model the second-order effects of a retail energy price cap introduced in the UK from January 2027: how energy suppliers, generators, Ofgem, the Treasury, and consumers respond over 12 months — supplier financial strain and exits, tariff restructuring, consumer switching behavior, investment signals for generation, and regulatory escalation.
